techParks.name: RMZ Infinity
techParks.description: Five-tower (A-E) RMZ office campus at No.3 Old Madras Road beside Benniganahalli and the Swami Vivekananda Road metro station. Google's own locations page lists its 'Old Madras Road' office here and Calix lists Tower B; OSM also records LSEG, EY, Alcon, Analog Devices and Thomson Reuters floors. Sabre, Wells Fargo and Kotak were suggested by the lens prompt but could not be confirmed here (Sabre now lists ITPB, Wells Fargo maps to Embassy TechVillage).

techParks.name: RMZ Millenia
techParks.description: Two-tower RMZ business park on Murphy Road, Ulsoor, next to the Israeli consulate. The only tenant evidenced in this pass is TMEIC's Bengaluru branch (OSM); the Deloitte, Oracle, Fidelity, Goldman Sachs and Ericsson names suggested for it could not be confirmed (their evidenced Bengaluru offices are elsewhere).

techParks.name: Divyasree Technopolis
techParks.description: DivyaSree's IT park at 124/125 Yemalur Main Road off Old Airport Road, east of HAL Airport, with the newer DivyaSree 77 East / 77 Town Centre blocks beside it. CGI's offices page confirms its Bengaluru centre here; OSM records Thomson Reuters and Deloitte. Centroid is derived from the OSM tenant POIs because the park polygon is not drawn in OSM. Walmart Global Tech, Microsoft, Myntra, Sapient, Hitachi and Mu Sigma, suggested by the lens prompt, could not be confirmed as tenants.

techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park
techParks.description: Bagmane's original campus on the lake at CV Raman Nagar / Byrasandra (buildings include Laurel, Lakeview, Parin and Cedar), between Old Madras Road and the DRDO complex. OSM records Texas Instruments, Dell's R&D centre, Motorola, Volvo Group India and a Cognizant block; none could be confirmed from company pages in this pass.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Magnificia
techParks.description: Salarpuria Sattva office block at 78 Old Madras Road (Swamy Vivekananda Road) near Tin Factory junction, Benniganahalli. OSM places OSB India, a Sattva office and a (possibly former) WeWork centre here and KreditBee just west of it; WeWork India's current Bengaluru list no longer names Old Madras Road. Pin is the OSM WeWork POI; no polygon is drawn.

techParks.name: Diamond District
techParks.description: Mixed-use IBC development on HAL Old Airport Road at Kodihalli whose commercial towers (A-C) house mid-size firms and startups; OSM records Zoomcar's office on the 7th floor of Tower B. Other tenants were not verified in this pass.

techParks.name: RMZ Titanium
techParks.description: RMZ office building at 135 HAL Old Airport Road, Kodihalli, opposite the Leela Palace. OSM nodes from 2015 name GKN Aerospace, FICO (Fair Isaac), CA Technologies, Amber Road, AmiCorp and Hyder Consulting as tenants, but none could be confirmed from company pages and several have since been acquired or moved, so no tenant is asserted.

techParks.name: Trifecta Adatto
techParks.description: Office tower at No.21 ITPL Main Road, Garudachar Palya, on the KR Puram-Mahadevapura border. Quantiphi's contact page confirms its Bengaluru office here and OSM records a McKinsey service centre (and a Flipkart office, not asserted).

techParks.name: ITC Infotech Park
techParks.description: ITC's own corporate campus at 18 Banaswadi Main Road, north of Ulsoor, housing ITC Infotech's global headquarters alongside the LEED-platinum ITC Green Centre. Confirmed by ITC Infotech's contact page; OSM polygon 'ITC'.

coverageNotes: Web search was unavailable for this run (shared per-turn budget exhausted before the first query), so every fact comes from direct fetches of company/government pages and Wikipedia plus the offline OpenStreetMap extracts; confidence is marked accordingly (high only where a company's own page or Wikipedia gives the address). CONFIRMED from primary pages: Google (3 offices incl. RMZ Infinity), Calix (RMZ Infinity Tower B), CGI (Divyasree Technopolis + 2 E-City), Synopsys (Bagmane Capital, not RMZ Infinity any more), Sabre (ITPB, not RMZ Infinity), Rolls-Royce (Manyata), Dynamatic (Aerospace Park + Peenya, not the HAL area), Aequs (Mahadevapura), Boeing BIETC, Tecnotree, ITC Infotech, Sattva, Enphase, Quantiphi, EY (CBD/Whitefield), ITI, plus Wikipedia-located HAL, NAL, ADA, BEML, URSC, LPSC, GTRE, ADE, LRDE, CAIR. NOT CONFIRMED and therefore not asserted: Wells Fargo, Kotak and Sabre at RMZ Infinity (Wells Fargo is mapped at Embassy TechVillage; Kotak appears only as retail branches); Deloitte, Oracle, Fidelity, Goldman Sachs and Ericsson at RMZ Millenia (only a TMEIC branch is evidenced there); Walmart Global Tech, Microsoft, Myntra, Publicis Sapient, Hitachi and Mu Sigma at Divyasree Technopolis (OSM puts Walmart at Prestige Tech Platina, Microsoft at Embassy GolfLinks, Sapient/Mu Sigma in Whitefield); Leela Galleria office tenants (none found); Embassy Prime (no park of that name could be located in Bengaluru; the geocoder returned Manyata); Bagmane Laurel (a building inside Bagmane Tech Park, listed as an alias); Prestige Khoday Tower (exists but is on Raj Bhavan Road in the CBD, outside this lens, so left to the CBD researcher). LEFT OUT deliberately: GKN Aerospace, FICO and CA Technologies at RMZ Titanium (2015 OSM nodes only, CA since absorbed into Broadcom at RMZ Ecospace); WeWork Salarpuria Magnificia (not on WeWork India's current Bengaluru list, closure date unknown); Flipkart at Trifecta Adatto (single OSM node, HQ is Embassy TechVillage in another lens); HSBC/MathCo/HPE/NetApp/Hitachi Energy nodes in Mahadevapura (other lens); NGEF, Coca-Cola and Coats industrial polygons on Old Madras Road (closed or unverified, pre-2023); Nielsen on Halasuru Road and Prestige Terminus tenants (unverified). Pins: where a company page gave an address but no POI or geocode hit existed, the pin is a park centroid (Sabre/ITPB, CGI E-City) or a locality point (Aequs at Mahadevapura, Dynamatic at Peenya 2nd Stage, TASL at Bhatramarenahalli) and confidence is lowered and the geocodeSource says so. HAL's Aircraft, Engine, Overhaul and Foundry & Forge divisions are grouped as one 'Bangalore Complex' office at HAL Airport because individual gates could not be geocoded; the Aerospace, Helicopter, ARDC and Tejas divisions have their own OSM polygons. DRDO's four labs and ISRO's three centres are grouped under one entry each because they are government bodies, not companies, and are flagged as such.
